summary: Existing target-only commits and available static checks are reconciled and passing, but CODE acceptance is incomplete because application value wiring, LLM Proxy storage safety, and executable consistency-evidence wiring remain unresolved.
validation: Helm lint and helm template passed for workspace-context and llm-proxy.
Repository unittest passed: 5 tests; Python compilation passed.
Application YAML parsing passed; explicit target and no-automated-sync checks passed.
Default llm-proxy render has no Deployment, Job, or Longhorn reference.
git diff --check passed; protected worker/bridge files and graphify-out are absent from implementation commits.
Current-run pipeline CI passed with no warnings or errors.
kubeconform, kubeval, and conftest are unavailable; no cluster or Argo validation was run.
blockers: apps/workspace-context.yaml uses className/accessMode/nas keys instead of the chart's storageClassName/accessModes/storage.graphArtifacts.nfs keys, so effective NAS wiring is not explicit.
apps/llm-proxy.yaml has stale source-secret fields and does not align with the chart's targetGates and nested llm-proxy values, so application-level safety and identity overrides are not trustworthy.
LLM Proxy has no 70% warning/85% critical PrometheusRule for its local-path PostgreSQL claim.
LLM Proxy backup scratch remains local-path instead of approved temporary/NFS scratch, and its worker static guard is absent from the commit.
Workspace Context evidence tooling references scratch/artifact paths but the gated job does not mount the configured PVCs, so the consistency bundle is not executable when enabled.
next_action: Keep the run at CODE. A future bounded CODE pass must resolve the listed wiring, storage-alert/scratch, and evidence-volume blockers before review; do not sync or deploy.

issues.title: Align target Argo value blocks with chart schemas
issues.details: Current committed app overrides do not target all values consumed by the two charts and include stale source-secret references.

issues.title: Add LLM Proxy storage alerts and approved scratch
issues.details: The LLM Proxy database lacks the required 70/85 capacity rules and backup scratch is not the approved temporary/NFS layout.

issues.title: Wire graph and logical dump evidence volumes
issues.details: The gated Workspace Context evidence job needs explicit configured PVC mounts before it can produce the coupled checksum and manifest bundle.
